responsibility: Defines the low-level SHORTREAL/string conversion interface for the gm2 ISO library. It declares the finite-state scanner entry point for real-number lexical analysis, routines to classify and parse SHORTREAL text, helpers that report the output length of floating, engineering, and fixed formatting, and the module-specific exception-state query used to detect invalid or out-of-range short-real conversions.
same_name_distinction: This .def file specifies the ShortConv API only, declaring the scanner, parsing, length, and exception-query entry points that are implemented in the companion ShortConv.mod.
